title: Nylas message.link_clicked notification object
description: Sent when a participant clicks a link in a tracked message. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

grant_id.description: The grant ID that owns the tracked message.

message_id.description: The ID of the tracked message containing the clicked link.

label.description: The tracking label you assigned when sending the message.

link_data.description: Aggregate click data per tracked link.

count.description: Total number of times this link was clicked.

recents.description: Recent click events with client details.

link_index.description: Index of the clicked link in the message.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of this click event.

user_agent.description: User-Agent string of the clicker's client.

sender_app_id.description: The Nylas application ID that sent the tracked message.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the click event.
